DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされたイヤホンは一組ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you lose a pair of earphones?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左だけです。右と充電ケースはここにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片耳のみの紛失だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only the left one. I have the right one and charging case here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish losing only one earpiece. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: なくした方を分かる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are there identifying features of the missing one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白色で、内側にLとあります。ケースの製品番号も見せられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残るケースの番号と左右の特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's white, with an L on the inside. I can show the case's product number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the remaining case's number and left-right identifying features. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に左を使った場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Where did you last use the left one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 公園のベンチです。ケースへ入れたと思いましたが、右だけ入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後の使用と収納の経過を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On a park bench. I thought I'd put it in the case, but only the right one was inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain its last use and how you put it away. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチ周辺は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you checked around the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻って足元を見ましたがありませんでした。端末の検索画面は古い位置なので、現在地とは断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 探索範囲と古い位置情報の限界を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I went back and looked on the ground but it wasn't there. The device's search screen shows an old location, so I can't say it's the current one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the area searched and the limits of old location data. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した範囲と、位置情報の時刻も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record the area checked and the time of the location information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 更新時刻は昨日六時です。左一個だけの届としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 更新時刻を示し片耳の届出を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It was updated at six yesterday. Please file the report for just the single left earpiece.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the update time and request a single-earpiece report. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。セットの残りが手元にあることも記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll also record that you have the rest of the set.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛名の方はお客様ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you the person named as recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。隣の部屋の知人です。入院中で受け取りに来られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入院中の知人宛てだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. It's an acquaintance in the next room. They're in hospital and can't come to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is addressed to an acquaintance in hospital. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様が代理で受け取るというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you're asking about collecting it on their behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。本人から頼まれましたが、口頭のお願いだけで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口頭依頼で代理受取できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They asked me, but is a verbal request enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether a verbal request allows collection on someone's behalf. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達物の種類と代理受取の条件を確認します。不在票を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the item type and representative-collection conditions. May I see the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どうぞ。本人の身分証を勝手に持ち出すのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不在票を示し本人書類を無断利用しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here you are. I'd like to avoid taking their identification without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the delivery notice and say you won't use their documents without permission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な物と取れる方法は、確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking, we'll explain what is needed and the available methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。受取できない場合は、本人へ何を確認するか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不可時に本人へ聞く項目を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. If I can't collect it, tell me what I should ask the recipient to confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to check with the recipient if collection isn't allowed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの連絡先で、本人から手続きの相談もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The recipient can also use this contact information to ask about the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を伝えます。今日は条件がそろわなければ受け取らず、不在票を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人連絡を優先し未確認なら受取を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pass it on. If the conditions aren't met today, I won't collect it; I'll take the notice home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize contact with the recipient and defer collection if unconfirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず配達物の取扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First we'll check how this delivery must be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紛失したカードの停止は確認できています。再発行についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We've confirmed that the lost card has been blocked. I'll explain reissue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。新しいカードはいつ、どう受け取りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再発行の時期と受取方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do. When and how will I receive the new card?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about reissue timing and collection method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取方法とお届けの目安を、この案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check this information for the delivery method and estimated arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日中は工場で働いています。郵便受けに入れてもらえる物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日中勤務と郵便受け配達の希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I work at a factory during the day. Can it be put in my mailbox?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention daytime work and your wish for mailbox delivery. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達の種類によって本人受取などの条件があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Depending on the delivery type, there may be conditions such as personal receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昼に受け取れない時の方法を、申請前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不在時の方法を申請前に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before applying, I'd like to check what to do if I can't receive it during the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about absence arrangements before applying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不在時の案内と受取先の条件をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain absence instructions and conditions for the delivery destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受取先を会社に変えるだけで解決できるとは限らないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社宛てへの任意変更で済まないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So simply changing the destination to my company won't necessarily solve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you cannot simply change it to your company at will. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録住所との関係も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We also need to check its relationship to your registered address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務時間を伝えます。方法が分かってから、必要な書類で再発行を申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務条件を示し受取案内後に申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell you my work hours. Once I understand the method, I'll apply for reissue with the necessary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your working circumstances and apply after receiving collection guidance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様が受け取れる条件を順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the conditions under which you can receive it one by one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてお気付きの点があったそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you noticed something about a product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 開けた食品に小さい硬い物がありました。何かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不明な硬い物を断定せず報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a small hard object in food I opened. I don't know what it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report an unknown hard object without identifying it as certain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べたり取り除いたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you eat it or remove it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その部分は食べていません。中に入ったまま、ふたを閉じてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食べず中に残した状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't eaten that part. It's still inside and I've closed the lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't eaten it and left it inside. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。包装と購入情報は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check. Do you still have the packaging and purchase information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残っています。破片だけ取り出して持って来た方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装保持と破片の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Should I take out only the fragment and bring it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you kept the packaging and ask how to handle the fragment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は動かさず、状態を保って担当の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: For now don't move it; keep it in that condition and wait for the staff's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。異物だと決めつけず、見た状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 動かさず観察した内容だけ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I won't decide that it's foreign material; I'll describe what I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave it untouched and describe only what you observed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開封の時刻と保管状況も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also ask when you opened it and how you stored it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝八時に開け、表示どおり保管しました。商品と包装を残して確認に協力します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開封時刻と保管状況を示して確認に応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I opened it at eight this morning and stored it as labeled. I'll keep the product and packaging and cooperate with the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give opening time and storage conditions and cooperate with checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ状態と購入情報を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass the condition and purchase information to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池の方へ下りようとされていますが、どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're about to go down toward the pond. What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帽子が飛んで、あの斜面に落ちました。手が届きそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 斜面へ落ちた帽子を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My hat blew away and landed on that slope. It looks within reach.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your hat fell on the slope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 斜面は足を滑らせるおそれがあります。園路から離れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You could slip on the slope. Please stay on the park path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで止まります。係員に取ってもらえるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立入らず係員の回収相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll stop here. I'd like to ask whether staff can retrieve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stay out and ask about retrieval by staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を確認します。帽子の色と落ちた辺りを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the location. Tell me its color and roughly where it fell.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤い帽子で、二本目の木の下です。今は水には入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と位置と水に入っていない状態を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a red hat, under the second tree. It isn't in the water at present.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give its color, position, and that it hasn't entered the water. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理担当へ知らせます。必ず回収できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll notify the management staff. Retrieval isn't guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。取れるまで下で待つのではなく、園路のベンチへ移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保証なしを理解し園路で待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than wait down there until it's retrieved, I'll move to the bench on the park path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand there is no guarantee and decide to wait on the park path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡できるよう管理棟にお名前をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Give your name at the administration building so they can contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理棟へ行きます。自分で枝を伸ばして取るのもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を伝え自力回収を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go to the administration building. I won't try reaching out with a branch to retrieve it myself either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give contact details and refrain from retrieving it yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。担当が安全を確認して対応をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Staff will check safety and explain how they can respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符の変更についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about changing tickets, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。三人分買いましたが、一人来られなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数減少による不要券を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I bought tickets for three people, but one can no longer come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an unneeded ticket due to fewer travelers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使わない券と、使う予定の券を分けて見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Show the unused ticket separately from those you plan to use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この一枚が不要です。まだどれも改札に入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用の一枚を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one is unneeded. None has gone through a ticket gate yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the single unused ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券種と条件を確認して、変更や払い戻しをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check ticket type and conditions and explain changes or refunds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に渡せばよいかとも思いましたが、名義や条件があるので先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人へ渡す前に券条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought of giving it to a friend, but I'd like to ask first because of names and conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask ticket conditions before giving it to another person. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認も含め、この券の条件をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain this ticket's conditions, including that point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。使う二枚まで取り消さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使う二枚を取消対象外と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Make sure you don't cancel the two we'll use as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clearly exclude the two tickets to be used from cancellation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この一枚だけを対象に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check only this single ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚は予定どおり使います。不要分の費用が分かったら手続きを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不要分の費用を聞いて手続きを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll use the two as planned. Once I know the costs for the unneeded one, I'll decide what procedure to take.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask costs for the unneeded ticket and decide the procedure. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。変更の条件と金額をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the change conditions and amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの用紙についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about this form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。これを返せば、案内のサービスに申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返送紙でサービス申込できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I send it back, can I apply for the service in the information?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether returning the paper applies for the service. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙はアンケートです。サービスの申請とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This paper is a questionnaire. It's separate from the service application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 希望する所に丸を付けても、利用申込みにはならないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望欄でも申込にならないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So circling what I want doesn't count as an application to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that even the preference section doesn't constitute an application. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。申請用の案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Here are the application instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: アンケートを出すかどうかと、利用の申込みを別々に考えます。必要な書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: アンケートと申請を分け必要書類を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll consider submitting the questionnaire and applying to use the service separately. Please tell me the necessary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the questionnaire and application and ask necessary documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申請の条件と確認資料をこの一覧でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check this list for application conditions and verification documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は足りない物があります。先にアンケートだけ出しても申請済みとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足資料と未申請状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't have everything today. Even if I send just the questionnaire first, I won't think I've applied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State missing documents and that you haven't applied. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請の受付完了は、提出後に別途ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm acceptance separately after submitting the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料をそろえて来ます。サービスを使える日も、申請しただけで決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料準備後の受付と利用開始を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll get the documents ready and return. I won't assume a service start date just because I've applied either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare documents and confirm acceptance and service start. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。利用開始の案内も申請時にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the service-start guidance when applying as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票に未記入の欄がありますが、書きにくい所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: There is a blank on your medical questionnaire. Is it difficult to fill in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。妊娠の可能性の欄です。ここでは人に聞こえるので話しにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 私的な問診欄を人前で話せないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, the possibility-of-pregnancy section. It's hard to discuss here because others can hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot discuss a private questionnaire section in public. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 看護師へ別の場所で相談する希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the nurse you'd like to consult somewhere else.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。分からないまま「ない」に丸を付けたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不確定な回答を記入しない意向を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I don't want to circle 'no' without knowing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you won't enter an uncertain answer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で確定できない内容は、そのまま担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell the staff directly about anything you cannot determine yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「可能性は分からないので確認したい」と伝えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 看護師に伝える内容を明確に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you tell them 'I don't know whether it's possible and would like to check'?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clearly request what to tell the nurse. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ほかの方に聞こえない説明方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. I'll also check a way to explain without others hearing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。問診票は伏せて手元に置き、看護師に直接渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問診票を伏せ直接渡すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll keep the questionnaire face down with me and hand it directly to the nurse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to keep the questionnaire face down and hand it over directly. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がご案内しますので、ここでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will guide you, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。診察や検査の前に、看護師へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察前に個別説明を受けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I'll speak to the nurse before the consultation or tests.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will receive a private explanation before the consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その希望を引き継ぎます。ご案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that wish on. Please wait until you're guided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらで鍵を拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did you find the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は拾っていません。公園にいた人から、警察へ届けてほしいと頼まれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分は拾得者でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I didn't find them. Someone in the park asked me to take them to the police.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are not the finder. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方は拾った場所を話していましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did that person say where they found them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 北のベンチと言っていました。私はその場を見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾得場所は伝聞だと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said the north bench. I didn't see the place myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the finding location as information heard from someone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 預かった時刻と場所は、ご自身で分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you personally know when and where you received them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日三時、公園の入口です。相手の名前は聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際に預かった時刻と場所を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today at three, at the park entrance. I didn't ask their name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the actual time and place you received them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 直接確認したことと、聞いたことを分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record what you confirmed yourself separately from what you heard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私が北のベンチで拾ったと書かれないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 直接拾った記録にならないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please don't write that I found them at the north bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask not to be recorded as having found them directly. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鍵を預かった後は、何か取り外しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Did you remove anything after receiving the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そのままです。輪に三本付いています。預かった入口からここまで直接来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預かり後の無変更と移動を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: They're unchanged. There are three on the ring. I came straight here from the entrance where I received them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe no changes after receipt and your movement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。引継ぎの経緯として伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll record the circumstances of the handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所が変わるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to change address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三週間帰国します。戻ったら同じ部屋に住むので、住所は変わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ住居に戻る一時帰国だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll return to my home country for three weeks. I'll live in the same room when I return, so my address won't change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a temporary home-country trip returning to the same home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では転居ではなく、不在中の郵便のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then this concerns mail during an absence, rather than moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。転居届を書きかけましたが、海外へ転送したいのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 海外転送でなく不在管理を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I started a moving notification, but I don't want forwarding overseas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request absence management rather than overseas forwarding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 不在の期間と郵便の種類に応じて、ご案内する方法が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The methods we can explain depend on the absence period and mail type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発は十日、帰りは三十日です。郵便受けにたまるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発帰宅日と郵便の滞留を懸念する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I leave on the tenth and return on the thirtieth. I'm worried about mail piling up in my mailbox.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give departure and return dates and concern about accumulated mail. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご利用できる保管などの条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the staff about conditions for available storage and other options.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。保管できない物があるなら、差出人にも出発前に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象外郵便は差出人対応も検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. If some items cannot be held, I'll contact their senders before leaving too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider contacting senders for mail outside the service scope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象と期間の案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you information on eligible items and the period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を確認し、一時不在として相談します。転居届は出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転居でなく一時不在の方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll read it and consult about a temporary absence. I won't submit a moving notification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose temporary-absence arrangements rather than moving. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご利用の条件が合うか順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11238-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check whether the usage conditions fit one by one.
